summary: Albums, films and books I'd hand you, with a sentence on why I like each one.

albums.title: OK Computer
albums.creator: Radiohead
albums.sentence: I put this on when someone tells me guitars ran out of ideas in the nineties.

albums.creator: The Beatles
albums.sentence: Putting twenty-seven number ones on one CD is showing off, even for the Beatles.

albums.title: Fearless
albums.creator: Taylor Swift
albums.sentence: This made me a Swiftie; I still play it when I need reminding to send the text before writing an album about it.

albums.title: All the Right Reasons
albums.creator: Nickelback
albums.sentence: "Photograph" is best sung badly, with the car windows up for everyone's sake.

albums.title: Discovery
albums.creator: Daft Punk
albums.sentence: "One More Time" is terrible advice when I have somewhere to be.

films.title: Parasite
films.creator: Bong Joon-ho
films.sentence: So good I had to watch it twice to get everything.

films.title: The Dark Knight
films.creator: Christopher Nolan
films.sentence: This is the best three hours I've spent watching a dark movie.

films.title: Interstellar
films.creator: Christopher Nolan
films.sentence: I love how earnestly it goes for the big feelings, and the score makes me want bigger speakers.

films.title: Pulp Fiction
films.creator: Quentin Tarantino
films.sentence: The dialogue makes me want to quote it in situations where I absolutely shouldn't.

films.title: 3 Idiots
films.creator: Rajkumar Hirani
films.sentence: I love a comedy that takes the pressure to succeed this seriously.

films.title: Up
films.creator: Pete Docter
films.sentence: The opening is emotional blackmail, and I am an embarrassingly easy target.

films.title: The Odyssey
films.creator: Christopher Nolan
films.sentence: I have a weakness for films that seem personally offended by the size of a television.

films.title: Spirited Away
films.creator: Hayao Miyazaki
films.sentence: The film I rewatch when I need to remember that hard work and kindness can be the same thing.

films.title: Shoah
films.creator: Claude Lanzmann
films.sentence: Nine and a half hours with no archive footage, and the one film I would never put a rating on.

books.title: Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs
books.creator: Harold Abelson and Gerald Jay Sussman with Julie Sussman
books.sentence: This made "(define (square x) (* x x))" read like a sentence to me, and it's why I still write <3 in code reviews.

books.title: It
books.creator: Stephen King
books.sentence: I read it at twelve and slept with the light on for a month; I still recommend it 🎈.

books.title: The Happiness Advantage
books.creator: Shawn Achor
books.sentence: This makes me want to put a good mood on the to-do list, somewhere above answering another email.

books.title: Harry Potter series
books.creator: J. K. Rowling
books.sentence: Even the school shopping makes me want to move in.

books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.creator: Jane Austen
books.sentence: The insults are so politely delivered that I almost want to be on the receiving end.

books.title: The Great Gatsby
books.creator: F. Scott Fitzgerald
books.sentence: I'd keep it for the sentences alone; I love prose that sounds this good read aloud.

books.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
books.creator: Harper Lee
books.sentence: I like how a child's voice makes the adults' excuses harder to hide behind.
